checks.name: DUR 하위(만기 미경과)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE TRY_CAST(DUR AS DOUBLE)>0 AND drv_maturity_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(DUR AS DOUBLE) ASC LIMIT 8

checks.name: 가능 상품 예시
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE upper(coalesce(pd_pen_tr_yn,''))='Y' AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 음수 괴리율 예시
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE TRY_CAST(du_diff_rt AS DOUBLE)<0 AND drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_diff_rt AS DOUBLE) ASC LIMIT 8

checks.name: 해외 채권형
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE wu_inv_ast_type='Bond' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

checks.name: 온라인×미징구
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_class WHERE han_clas_fee_type='수수료미징구' AND han_clas_sales_channel ILIKE '%온라인%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

checks.name: 미국 국채 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm LIKE '%미국%국채%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%미국채%')

checks.name: 3중 상위
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='국공채' AND TRY_CAST(DUR AS DOUBLE)>5 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

checks.name: 30%초과 편입
checks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.etf_name, e.pd_abrv_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO,',','') AS DOUBLE)>30 AND e.drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 월배당×저보수
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_pay_cnt AS INT)>=12 AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)>0 AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)<0.5 AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 순자산 하위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE)>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) ASC LIMIT 8

checks.name: 평균 추적오차
checks.sql: SELECT round(avg(TRY_CAST(du_chas_errt AS DOUBLE)),2) FROM kr_etp WHERE (cu_base_index ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR ref_base_index ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%') AND TRY_CAST(du_chas_errt AS DOUBLE)>0 AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 최고값
checks.sql: SELECT max(TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE)) FROM fund_master WHERE zrin_btyp_nm='채권형' AND TRY_CAST(fd_yr1_ern_r AS DOUBLE)<>0
